scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @cooffeup/api" "npm run dev -w @cooffeup/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cooffeup/shared && npm run build -w @cooffeup/api && npm run build -w @cooffeup/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cooffeup/shared && npm run test -w @cooffeup/shared && npm run test -w @cooffeup/api
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
